description: Modified FINAT FTM 10-type 180 degree release-liner peel datasets, processed source values for material-property and water-contact-angle tables, analysis code, locked-environment requirements, a passing verification report, and regenerated manuscript tables and figures for a study of slip-stick dynamics in butyl pressure-sensitive adhesive and silicone release-liner systems. Data, generated outputs, documentation, and metadata are released under CC BY 4.0; software code is released under the MIT License. Funding: This work was funded by the Minister of Education and Science (Poland) under the “Doktorat wdrożeniowy” programme (6th edition; Implementation Doctorate Programme), grant number DWD/6/0325/2022, implemented in cooperation with Almara sp. z o.o. sp.k. as the industrial partner.
